mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods show no significant positive skew (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for 3 consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 months or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL inflation above 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rate above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces real equity returns, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances or joint effect p-value > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), labor market slack suppresses wage pressures and supports continued monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) in UNRATE > 5.0 periods or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns show no significant positive skew compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200.0 thousand units, it signals robust consumer demand and economic confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of HOUST > 1200.0 instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous HOUST above 1200.0 and RSAFS above 500,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending momentum that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances or joint effect p-value > 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), declining industrial production signals weakening economic activity and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of INDPRO < 100.0 instances or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
